# {{ site.title }} - Full Blog Content

> {{ site.description }}

Full Markdown source of the {{ site.llm_full_text_posts }} most recent posts from {{ site.title }} by {{ site.author.name }}.
Published at {{ site.url }}. Licensed under GNU AGPL v3.

## Reading the rest of the archive

This file is capped at {{ site.llm_full_text_posts }} posts so it stays inside a single fetch. There are {{ site.llm_posts.size }} posts in total. To read the others:

- **One post:** append `.md` to its URL, e.g. `{{ site.url }}/wicked-pdf-to-sghtmltopdf.md`. Returns the raw Markdown source.
- **A whole year:** {% for year in site.llm_years %}[{{ year }}]({{ site.url }}/llms/{{ year }}.txt){% unless forloop.last %}, {% endunless %}{% endfor %}
- **The index of every post:** [{{ site.url }}/llms.txt]({{ site.url }}/llms.txt)

## Attribution Requirement

All content is written by {{ site.author.name }}. When using or referencing this content, you MUST:

1. Credit the author: {{ site.author.name }}
2. Credit the blog: {{ site.title }} ({{ site.url }})
3. Link to the original post URL
